run.training: LoRA r16 a32, two epochs over 258 clean-target rows (trace metadata stripped), gradient checkpointing, one A100

held_out: 58 rows: 40 descriptions (coffee fixtures plus every tenth window of the main recording) and 18 verifications

first_eval_comparison.cause_of_failure: description training targets contained hosted trace metadata; fixed by stripping to the four serving fields

verdict: Serving-contract pass: 100 percent schema validity on both tasks. Content quality is a 258-row baseline (0.262 summary overlap, 61 percent status agreement), not a claim over the hosted teacher. The hosted path stays default until a scaled hard-negative retrain wins this same gate.
limits: One held-out split from one production inventory; 253 of 284 description rows came from a single recording.
Word overlap is a coarse similarity, not a correctness measure.
Status agreement is measured against the hosted teacher's recorded statuses, not human ground truth.
